description: Source code for managing an X11 window with custom compositing, including video frame handling and manual rendering, specific to Raspberry Pi 4 64-bit environment.

classes.name: SbWindowPrivate
classes.description: Class managing an X11 window with custom compositing, video frame rendering, and event handling.

methods.name: HasNeededExtensionsForPunchedOutVideo
methods.description: Checks if the display supports necessary X extensions for punched-out video rendering.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::SbWindowPrivate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the X11 window, setting up visual info, colormap, and rendering surfaces.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::~SbWindowPrivate
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up X11 resources such as pixmaps, pictures, and windows.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::BeginComposite
methods.description: Prepares the compositing buffer, handles resize events, and clears the composition pixmap.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::CompositeVideoFrame
methods.description: Uploads a video frame to an X11 pixmap, applies transformations, and composites it into the scene.

methods.name: SbWindowPrivate::EndComposite
methods.description: Finalizes the compositing by blending GL output and rendering the composed frame to the window.
